name: automation_create
summary: Make Sam do something automatically: at a time ('every weekday at 8: morning briefing', 'Fridays 16:00 weekly report') or when something happens / holds ('when a new email from X arrives…', 'if a task is overdue…', 'when a meeting ended…', 'if a deadline is 2 days away and the task is open…', 'when a file appears in folder Y…'). Runs in the background; actions that need approval still ask.

args.name: string: short label
args.request: string: what Sam should do each time — the user's own words, without the timing and without adding anything they didn't ask for (no extra delivery channel such as chat or email unless named; results arrive as a notification)
args.every_min: int (schedule every N minutes, or how often a watch checks; default 15)
args.when: string (watch): the event or condition in the user's words
